Key Manager (KeyM)

Manages lifecycle, storage, and distribution of cryptographic keys and certificates.

Typen — Übersicht

  • struct KeyM_ConfigType This structure is the base type to initialize the Key Manager module.
  • KeyM_KH_UpdateOperationType Specifies the type of key handler update operation that was performed in the callback.
  • struct KeyM_CertElementIteratorType This structure is used to iterate through a number of elements of a certificate.
  • KeyM_CryptoKeyIdType Crypto key handle.
  • KeyM_CertDataPointerType Byte - pointer to the data of the certificate
  • KeyM_StartType This type specifies in which mode the key operation will start.
  • KeyM_CertElementIdType Certificate Element handle.
  • KeyM_CertificateIdType Certificate handle.
  • KeyM_ServiceCertificateType This type specifies the requested service operation and what information is provided with this function.
  • Max Array long enough to store the key or certificate name.
  • enum KeyM_CertificateStatusType Type KeyM_CertificateStatusType.
  • KeyM_CertificateElementType Array long enough to store data
  • KeyM_CryptoKeyDataType Byte - pointer to the input or output data
  • enum KeyM_ResultType Specifies the result type of an asynchronous key management fu nction.
  • struct KeyM_CertDataType This structure is used to exchange certificate data through interface functions.

function KeyM_Prepare [SWS_KeyM_00051] 📄 PDF
Std_ReturnType KeyM_Prepare (const uint8* Request Data, uint16 Request Data Length, uint8* Response Data, uint16* Response Data Length);

This function is used to prepare a key update operation. The main intent is to provide information for the key operation to the key server. Other operations may start the negotiation for a common secret that is used further to derive key material. This function is only av ailable if Key MCrypto Key Prepare Function Enabled is set to TRUE.

function KeyM_CertificateElementGetCount [SWS_KeyM_91015] 📄 PDF
Std_ReturnType KeyM_CertificateElementGetCount (KeyM_CertificateIdType CertId, KeyM_CertElementIdType Cert ElementId, uint16* CountPtr);

This function provides the total number of data elements that a re available for the specified certificate element. Typically, only one data element is available. But in some cases, several data elements can be assigned to one certificate element in a row. This function retrieves the total number of elements. The indiv idual data elements can then accessed with Key M_ Certificate Element Get By Index(). It is similar to the functions Key M_ Cert Element Get First/ Key M_ Cert Element Get Next to retrieve a group of data elements of one certificate element. AUTOSAR CP R20 - of

If the configuration parameters Key MCrypto Key Prepare Function Enabled and Key MCrypto Key Handler Prepare Enabled are both set to TRUE, then this function w ill be called immediately when Key M_ Prepare gets called. The function takes over the task to prepare a key management operation. The response data will be passed on as is to the caller of Key_ Prepare.
